title: Model-Agnostic Meta Learning for Differentiable MPC
summary: Applying policy optimization to Model Predictive Control (MPC) yields high-performance and reliable controllers. However, the resulting controllers often overfit their training conditions and suffer significant performance degradation in unseen tasks. We propose a novel framework combining policy optimization with meta-learning to train highly adaptable MPC controllers. Our approach enables rapid adaptation to unseen tasks, maintaining high performance at a fraction of the computational cost required for full retraining.
